description: This file is a shell script used for collecting system metrics and system information, including network MAC addresses, CPU model, memory info, and system uptime, and writing this data into log files.

methods.name: setLogFile
methods.description: Sets the log file path based on the provided suffix and removes any existing log file.

methods.name: getEthMac
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the Ethernet interface, depending on device type.

methods.name: getCpuModel
methods.description: Extracts the CPU model name from /proc/cpuinfo.

methods.name: populateSystemInfo
methods.description: Collects and logs system information such as image name, MAC address, date, hostname, kernel version, CPU model, uptime, and OpenSSL version.

methods.name: populateSysMemInfo
methods.description: Collects and logs memory-related information from /proc/meminfo.

methods.name: populateSysCPUInfo
methods.description: Collects and logs CPU usage statistics from /proc/stat.

methods.name: calc_bogo_ops
methods.description: Calculates and logs benchmark metrics based on input parameters.
